title: The Song of Love in the Song of Songs
description: At the end of the Song of Songs, the bride asks to be set as a seal on her beloved's heart. Love is described as strong as death, with flames like the Lord's fire that no waters can quench.

versions.title: The Song of Love in the Song of Songs
versions.description: The Song of Songs describes the intense love between the groom and the bride, celebrating love as stronger than death.
versions.reason: [minor] references: The passage 8:5-14 covers the conclusion of the Song of Songs well, but the core of 'the song of love' is verses 6-7. Still, it is reasonable to include the entire final chapter.; [minor] description: The description is correct, but could have mentioned the seal on the heart as a central image.
